name: darlendar
title: Darlendar
description: Show the current date in the macOS menu bar, formatted with a custom dayjs format.
author: CaffeineCat

commands.name: show-darlendar-in-menubar
commands.title: Show Darlendar in Menubar
commands.description: Display the formatted current date in the menu bar.

preferences.name: format
preferences.title: Menu Bar Date Format
preferences.description: dayjs format string shown in the menu bar title, e.g. YYYY/MM/DD

preferences.name: listFormat
preferences.title: List Date Format
preferences.description: dayjs format string used for the day items in the dropdown list, e.g. MM/DD ddd

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
